content.text: {"role":"COO","professional_background":"Rose through plant management and regional service operations before taking enterprise responsibility for manufacturing, logistics, and shared services. Led a multi-site consolidation and two ERP-adjacent rollouts, one of which stalled and had to be restarted with heavier change management. Comfortable reading process data and standing on a shop floor. Reports operational performance to the board and owns most of the company's headcount.","professional_background_note":"","decision_priorities":["Throughput and cycle-time improvement","Frontline adoption without productivity dips","Integration with existing scheduling and quality systems","Vendor's implementation and support depth","Clear operational metrics for benefit tracking"],"risk_attitude":"Accepts calculated risk where a pilot can prove the workflow before wider commitment, but resists anything that disrupts live service delivery.","time_horizon":"Looks for visible operational gains within the current fiscal cycle and durable process capability over several years.","organizational_constraints":["Limited internal capacity for parallel change programs","Unionized and shift-based workforce requiring negotiated training time","Legacy plant systems with uneven data quality","Capital plan already committed to facility upgrades"]}
